scope.kind: Analysis of the local points in rmMaskLayerV7 with exact frozen Float32 coverage; released v2 graph operator mask_tone_v3.
scope.source: Two independently verified Sony RAW captures, pinned FlashRaw 0.3.1 original EXIF 1 opaque native RGBA16F, macOS 27.0.1 Apple M4 Max. All color math is extended-linear sRGB FP32 with signed sRGB inside the original operator. No GPU timing claims.
scope.operatorInput: Headless named Float32 plane in [0,1]. The analytic ellipse is a separately measured producer. Zero feather still has a 1e-5 transition after normalized distance 1. No use of Gray8, polygon approximations, or early finite checks for composed graphs.
scope.reference: Normal DevelopmentRendererV3.develop plus V3PreviewMaterializer 2400. For every state the independent stock absolute native RGBAf bands and their unmodified hardware .5 sampler have the archived final sRGB8 digest.
scope.display: 2400x1600 archive, both states of eight production controls. The standalone Rust/Naga WGSL kernel and hardware sampler compared every native and half pixel including alpha and rejected nonfinite participation.
scope.productionNote: The v2 grammar is additive. Public v2 CPU and attached GPU consume the normal borrowed covered frame through existing named-mask ABI. The existing canonical private source/curves half API retains its narrower contract.
scope.strictSourceBounds: Only the original opaque finite half source permits the finite bound stated here: max |component| 65504, exposure up to 16x, black denominator >=0.9, active tone divides only by |luma|>1e-8, signed hue divides only for hi>1e-8. Arbitrary finite FP32 input with subnormal alpha can overflow on unpremultiplication; the CPU returns an error for that case; see the positive subnormal Metal counterexample.
scope.CICacheCorrection: A diagnostic trying to write stock RGB and coverage from separate CI graphs using a single context produced a zero stock control. It was excluded. Accepted runs use separate real contexts/queues, and independently reject the run unless stock native-band FIT is the archived native-render display.

linuxVulkanCounterexample.backend: Mesa llvmpipe 22.3.6 software Vulkan, Linux arm64

extractedSingleRecord.sourceFormat: linear-sRGB Float32 physical source values expanded exactly from opaque RGBA16F
extractedSingleRecord.observed: Full public C ABI replay used 12800 samples. Single-record term extracted offline. The one-pixel dispatch was not independently rerun.

performanceBoundary.interpretation: Counterfactual only. The stored planes and GPU host routing carry costs. The median remains above the gate even at zero cost for all 16 states.

publicMetalVerdict.handles: Two independent successful process exits. Each native band bound the real v2 IOSurface frame, joined its render, called frame close and rechecked the source owner. The loops executed 16*(25+23)=768 bands. All 32 plans/programs and the per-height IOSurface owners have scoped destructors. Counts from fixed geometry and code, not an allocation-leak measurement.

extendedF32Counterexample.normalSmallestAlphaBits: 0x00800000 at coverage 1 returns 3 on both; coverage 0 preserves source bits
extendedF32Counterexample.scope: The finite opaque FlashRaw fixtures are unaffected. Cross-runtime error identity for extremely small positive alpha outside the established source domain is unproven. Route this domain to CPU when deterministic rejection is required.
